Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in comparing the birth dates of the two directors. The retrieved data clearly showed T. V. Chandran was born in 1950 and Julia Crawford Ivers was born in 1869 (or 1867). The Planner incorrectly concluded that 1869 (or 1867) is a later date than 1950, stating that Julia Crawford Ivers was born later. This is a fundamental failure in chronological reasoning, where a date in the 19th century was mistakenly identified as being "later" than a date in the 20th century.
